name: Price
summary: A price as a shop sets it: the currency sign small and raised, the number large and bold. A lower price has a line under it naming the earlier price ("Previous price €549"); the lowest prices sit in a box of the highlight colour. The look (sizes, weight, raised sign, box, offset) is the c.price tokens, which a template theme sets (Q139 R4). Not for a sum in a summary or an order total (use DescriptionList with the formatted amount) or a figure (use Statistic).
a11y: The drawn price is hidden from assistive technology and one plain phrase is read instead ("€499, Previous price €549"), so the split sign and number aren't read as two things. The earlier price is in words, never only a strike.

props.name: value
props.description: The price now, in whole or decimal units of `currency`.

props.name: was
props.description: The earlier, higher price, so this is a lower price: written in the line under it.

props.name: wasLabel
props.description: The line under a lower price with the earlier price filled in, in the page's language: "Previous price €549". The bare earlier price when left out.

props.name: size
props.description: `m` (default) in a card, tile or line; `l` on the thing's own page.

props.name: highlight
props.description: The lowest-price box: the price on the highlight colour. A theme gives it a solid offset through `c.price.highlight-offset`.

props.name: decimals
props.description: Digits after the point; 0 (default) for whole prices, 2 for cents.

props.name: locale
props.description: A locale for the number; the reader's own when left out.
